title: Kafsokalyvia skete: Maximus the flying monk who burned his huts

tellings.quote: this is named in in the honor of one of the saints we have here Saint Kaffa so he was known as Maximus the monk. He was not not Otis Maximus and he was known as a flying monk and he burned his huts and he had these miracles and they were sightings of him flying.

plain: Kafsokalyvia, a small cluster of monks' dwellings on Mount Athos, the Greek peninsula of Orthodox monasteries, is named for a saint known as Maximus, a "flying monk" who burned his huts, worked miracles, and was seen flying. Ralph Larson tells Michels he heard this in 2005 from a young monk who looked after the place, which would make it a local memory of a man said to have flown.
